technical.summary: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 95+, Stoch 92+) with bearish stochastic cross and weak ADX trend confirmation create high pullback risk despite bullish structure and massive volume spike.

fundamental.summary: GD shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 51 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (35 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity neutral with no significant insider conviction; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (455.8), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, with earnings event 51 days out adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme overbought RSI (95+) with massive 15x volume spike and price above all major moving averages suggests institutional accumulation despite macro headwinds, offering contrarian entry in fear-zone environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Stochastic bearish cross, weak ADX trend confirmation (24.49), compressed Bollinger Bands, zero fundamental support, and crisis-level VIX (455.8) with earnings risk in 51 days create high pullback probability that outweighs technical overbought extremes.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme overbought RSI (95+) with 15x volume spike suggests institutional accumulation, but stochastic bearish cross and weak ADX trend confirmation (24.49) signal imminent pullback risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity in fear-zone environment.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (455.8), stochastic bearish cross, and compressed Bollinger Bands create high probability of sharp pullback before earnings event in 51 days, with weak trend confirmation offering no safety net.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate all converge on bear case; sentiment alone offers contrarian signal but insufficient to override consensus.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding GD with 54 existing Industrials positions (22% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and warrant skip decision.
